<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at 5.2.2 -->

## What's Changed
### Bug Fixes 🐛
* Backport: Remove unsupported ENCRYPTEDSTRING project property type by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/frontend/pull/2119
### Dependency Updates 🤖
* Bump nginxinc/nginx-unprivileged from 1.31.6-alpine3.24 to 1.31.7-alpine3.24 in /docker by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/frontend/pull/2030
* Bump @codemirror/autocomplete from 6.20.3 to 6.20.4 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/frontend/pull/2031
* Bump the codeql group with 2 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/frontend/pull/2033
* Bump docker/login-action from 4.6.0 to 4.7.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/frontend/pull/2044
* Bump zizmorcore/zizmor-action from 0.7.1 to 0.8.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/frontend/pull/2045
* Bump zizmorcore/zizmor-action from 0.8.0 to 0.8.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/frontend/pull/2081
* Bump the codeql group with 2 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/frontend/pull/2088
* Bump the codeql group with 2 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/frontend/pull/2092
* Bump docker/login-action from 4.7.0 to 4.8.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/frontend/pull/2098
* Backport: Move the container base image to nginx/nginx-unprivileged 1.31.8 by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/frontend/pull/2116
* Backport: Change nginx base image to slim variant (drop extra packages and their CVEs) by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/frontend/pull/2118
* Backport: Bump nginx base image to 1.31.9 to resolve various vulns by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/frontend/pull/2122
### Other Changes
* Backport: Preserve custom banner HTML code in editor on page load by @nscuro in https://github.com/DependencyTrack/frontend/pull/2117


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/DependencyTrack/frontend/compare/5.2.1...5.2.2

# OWASP Dependency-Track Frontend

Frontend module of [Dependency-Track](https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track),
the intelligent Component Analysis platform that allows organizations to identify and reduce risk
in the software supply chain.

[![Build Status](https://github.com/DependencyTrack/frontend/actions/workflows/ci-build.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/DependencyTrack/frontend/actions/workflows/ci-build.yaml)
[![Documentation](https://img.shields.io/badge/read-docs-blue.svg)](https://dependencytrack.github.io/docs/)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-Apache--2.0-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Looking for Dependency-Track v4?**
>
> - v4 is in maintenance mode on the [`4.14.x` branch](https://github.com/DependencyTrack/frontend/tree/4.14.x).
> - v4 documentation: <https://dependencytrack.github.io/docs/4.x>.
> - Migrating from v4 to v5? See [V5_MIGRATION.md](https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track/blob/main/V5_MIGRATION.md).
> - v4 will reach end-of-life in December 2026, *~6 months* after v5 GA.

## Documentation

User-facing documentation is rendered at <https://dependencytrack.github.io/docs/> and maintained in the [docs](https://github.com/DependencyTrack/docs) repository.

## Contributing

1. [Code of conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)
2. [Developer guide](DEVELOPING.md)

## Community

Dependency-Track is an open source project maintained by a community of contributors.
Join the [monthly community meeting](https://github.com/DependencyTrack/community#community-meetings)
to hear project updates, ask questions, and meet other users and maintainers.

## See also

- [dependency-track](https://github.com/DependencyTrack/dependency-track): Main repository
- [docs](https://github.com/DependencyTrack/docs): Documentation repository
- [helm-charts](https://github.com/DependencyTrack/helm-charts): [Helm](https://helm.sh/) charts
- [community](https://github.com/DependencyTrack/community): Community resources
